name: MaRVL-QA
description: MaRVL-QA is a benchmark designed to evaluate mathematical reasoning over visual landscapes, focusing on structured spatial analysis from images. It includes tasks such as Topological Counting and Transformation Recognition to test models' abilities to identify local extrema and detect geometric transformations.
reputation: A very recent niche benchmark from the MaRVL line of work, with limited but growing attention in multimodal reasoning research.
notes: Focuses on mathematical reasoning from visual data using surface plots; reveals current MLLMs struggle with robust strategies.
